attempted: fuzz the plugin API with malformed bodies and traversal-shaped ids, from outside and from inside the page
outcome: aborted as inconclusive: requests returned 405/404 before reaching the handler, and a follow-up run showed the panel never mounted in that profile (no review-outbox requests captured), so the results say nothing about the handler
whyNotPursued: the handler already has eight host-level tests covering auth rejection, unknown actions, missing items and corrupt state; reproducing the mount condition was taking longer than the round allowed, and a fuzz that never reaches the code under test is worse than no fuzz
whatWasShippedInstead: both READMEs now state which install form keeps updating, based on the measured pin behaviour
lesson: an API fuzz needs the mounted panel as a precondition; verifying the precondition costs less than interpreting empty results
